said on Wednesday that it plans to raise about C$8.5M via a public offering of 9.45M units at C$0.90 per unit.
Each unit includes 1 common share and 1 warrant, with each warrant exercisable at C$1.10 per share for 36 months.
The agents have an option to purchase up to an additional 15% of the offering to cover potential over-allotments.
The net proceeds will be used to advance its Clearwater Lithium Project and for general working capital.
The offering is expected to close around September 24, 2026, subject to regulatory and TSX Venture Exchange approval.

title: E3 LITHIUM plans C$8.5M raise to advance Clearwater Lithium project
